properties.name: WHAT WORKED (hxm_program, 2026-09-28): the Stop-hook nudge caught two graph writes with no propagate_change, fired once, and the blast radius it prompted came back with nothing owed — "cheap and correct"
properties.statement:
Recorded so a regression is checkable. Reporter (the hxm_program hub, 2026-09-28): "The Stop-hook nudge caught a real skip. Two graph writes and no `propagate_change`: the nudge fired once, the blast radius was computed, and nothing was owed. That's cheap and correct." The same hub, 2026-08-25/26: "The harness's Stop hook did fire once ('1 graph write and no loop check') and was correct."
What must not regress: once per session, and only on a real skip.
NOTE, from the same triage (fact:root-cause-a-stateless-caller-is-named-by-the-mcp-librarys-default-2026-09-28): the probe this nudge spawns appears in the usage ledger as a harness called `rmcp`, which is how the hub's first /feedback report met it as an unattributable client.
